raw.retention: Keep the two complete Sicily release years locally until a reviewed remote archive exists.

canonical.retention: Keep monthly canonical arrays locally only within quota; immutable archives belong in object storage.

published.retention: Monthly serving products only; daily arrays are forbidden.

composite_cache.retention: Evict by lifecycle policy; cache contents are reproducible and never authoritative.

tiles.retention: Evict by lifecycle policy; cache contents are reproducible and never authoritative.

annual_estimates.basis: Conservative pre-acquisition Sicily estimates for a 16 by 17 provider grid; replace with measured release bytes after retrieval.

temporal_retention.daily_source_policy: Archive outside local serving storage after checksum and monthly-product validation.
temporal_retention.serving_store_policy: Monthly layers only; selected UI months receive equal weight.
